acceptance_on_test: The DEV pick is then checked once on TEST against Opus (Rdb54680: 290/1002 matches, 79.5% recall, 28.9% precision). It 'matches or beats Opus' if TEST matches >= 290. Precision is reported next to Opus's. TEST results of every config are reported but never used to choose.

added_formats.chat-default: dspy.ChatAdapter() with DSPy's default automatic JSONAdapter fallback enabled (every fallback call counted as a model call), 8,192 output tokens
added_formats.json-default: dspy.JSONAdapter() as shipped by DSPy 3.3.1 (its own response_format choice), 8,192 output tokens

added_formats_scope: both models x arms A/B/C x DEV/TEST, same decoding as the plan (temperature 0, seed 9, thinking off, no response cache, no transport retries)
added_pools: per model x arm x stage: chat-default + json-default; and the original pools unchanged

added_stages.filtered-ordinary-noverify: ordinary relevance filter applied directly to the combined records
added_stages.filtered-title-noverify: title-aware relevance filter applied directly to the combined records (no LLM verifier)

added_stages_scope: every cohort, including the original three formats
authorization: Owner in chat 2026-09-25: no Passau models; add plain DSPy default formats; use as few LLM runs as possible; must match or beat Opus on TEST.
pick_rule_replaced: Selection uses DEV only. Among eligible configs with DEV recall >= 80% (>= 92/115) and DEV precision >= 15%, pick the config with the fewest LLM calls (extraction + verifier, including fallbacks) on DEV; configs within 10% of the fewest calls count as tied and the tie goes to higher DEV precision. If none reaches 80% DEV recall, pick the highest DEV recall with precision >= 15%.
